messages:
julia: Quick sync — planning a PLG activation experiment next week: free credits + onboarding prompt templates + a short benchmark narrative + a webinar tie-in. Need final launch post copy, webinar signup flow, and the in-app activation nudge. Who can own what? :calendar:

sam: I can own the credits matrix and A/B design. Proposal: test $50 vs $150 credits for new signups, and vary expiry (7d vs 30d). Metric: 7-day activated projects / signups.

own: For the benchmark narrative, we should pick one representative workload (search/rerank or summarization). Want to show latency & cost per 1k tokens for hosted vs dedicated. I can draft numbers if analytics agrees.

tara: I’ll build 3 starter prompt packs for onboarding: 
- "Search assistant" (search+rerank examples)
- "Customer support" (thread summarization + suggested replies)
- "Product copywriter" (short marketing outputs)
I’ll upload to the template repo and add preview cards.

nora: Nice. From recent cohort data: with a small credit incentive we saw a +12% lift in first-run conversions; larger credits increase mean token usage but drop 1-week retention slightly. Suggested priors: target activation rate delta of +8pp for the larger credit. Also recommend cohorting by signup-source (docs vs blog vs webinar).

sam: Draft of in-app/email nudge copy, feel free to copy/edit:
```
Subject: You’ve got $150 in Redwood credits — try a prompt pack
Hi {{first_name}},
Welcome! We added $150 in trial credits to your account. Try a Starter Prompt Pack to see results fast: [Use Search Pack] [Use Support Pack]
Tip: run one sample request (under 30s) to unlock usage tips in-app.
— The Redwood Team
```
This is short and action-oriented. We should A/B CTA language: "Try pack" vs "Run sample".

julia: Love it. Two asks: 1) finalize exact credit amounts and expiry by EOD Friday, 2) marketing needs a 120–150 word launch post and a webinar landing description by Monday. Owen/nora — can you sync on which workload we'll benchmark?

own: I can pair with nora tomorrow 10am PT to pick the workload and slice.

nora: Confirmed — will bring sample metrics.

tara: I’ll aim to have the prompt packs pushed and preview cards by Friday afternoon.

sam: I’ll wire up the A/B in Growth experiments and add tracking events: signup_source, credits_offered, first_request_ts, activated_flag.

julia: For the webinar — format: 25 min demo, 10 min Q&A, and a short mini-benchmark walkthrough. We want the webinar sign-up to auto-grant credits on registration. Can deploy-bot schedule the webinar announcement post and attach the registration link? :sparkles:

deploy-bot: Scheduled message to #marketing for 1758470000 with registration link: https://redwood.ai/events/plg-activation-demo.

julia: Final note on comms tone: emphasize "fast time-to-value" + "predictable cost controls". Avoid deep infra details; include one concrete benchmark (e.g., "~10ms token latency on common prompts") in the blog/update.

own: Will provide a simple table and one chart for the post.

sam: I’ll prepare experiment dashboard and share post-launch playbook for follow-ups (email cadence + in-app nudges).

julia: Great. Action items summarized: 
- sam: credits A/B experiments & tracking
- owen + nora: pick workload + benchmark numbers
- tara: prompt packs + preview cards
- sam + tara: in-app nudge + email copy
- julia: launch post + webinar blurb (draft Monday)
Everyone, please drop any blocking questions here. :+1:
